title: Follow one input to its output
captions: The starter doubles five input values.
Follow input[2] to output[2]. How does the thread choose that position?
speech: The starter doubles five input values.
Follow input at index two to output at index two. How does the thread choose that position?

title: The inputs are already in GPU memory
captions: The supplied setup already copies the inputs into GPU memory.
Leave that setup unchanged for this experiment.
speech: The supplied setup already copies the inputs into GPU memory.
Leave that setup unchanged for this experiment.

title: Find the selected thread’s index
captions: We follow block zero’s local thread two.
Zero times four, plus two, gives array index two.
speech: We follow block zero’s local thread two.
Zero times four, plus two, gives array index two.

title: One index selects both positions
captions: The same index selects input[2] and output[2].
speech: The same index selects input at index two and output at index two.

title: The SM executes the thread
captions: An SM, or streaming multiprocessor, is execution hardware on the GPU chip.
It runs the selected thread’s instructions.
speech: An SM, or streaming multiprocessor, is execution hardware on the GPU chip.
It runs the selected thread’s instructions.

title: Read input[2] from GPU memory
captions: The thread reads 3.0 from input[2] in GPU memory.
That value becomes working state for its instructions on the SM.
speech: The thread reads three point zero from input at index two in GPU memory.
That value becomes working state for its instructions on the SM.

title: Shared hardware performs the multiply
captions: The SM’s arithmetic hardware multiplies 3.0 by 2.0, producing 6.0.
Threads keep their own working values while sharing this hardware.
speech: The SM’s arithmetic hardware multiplies three point zero by two point zero, producing six point zero.
Threads keep their own working values while sharing this hardware.

title: Write the matching output position
captions: The thread writes 6.0 to output[2] in GPU memory.
Its index fixes the destination even if other threads finish first.
speech: The thread writes six point zero to output at index two in GPU memory.
Its index fixes the destination even if other threads finish first.

title: The CPU prints the copied results
captions: main copies the GPU results into CPU memory and prints Output.
speech: main copies the GPU results into CPU memory and prints Output.

title: Compare your result
captions: With 4.0f, input[2] still supplies 3.0 and output[2] becomes 12.0.
The same index chooses the destination; the SM still performs the multiply.
speech: With four point zero f, input at index two still supplies three point zero and output at index two becomes twelve point zero.
The same index chooses the destination; the SM still performs the multiply.
